contradictions_with_findings.contradiction: Pre-compaction notes stated BSF_Holster (bit 8) routes to FUN_00e7b4c0 in FUN_00e01c90. Assembly analysis of 00e01c90 shows all TEST instructions use BL (low byte only). Bit 8 (mask 0x100) is in the second byte and is NOT tested. No TEST EBX,0x100 instruction exists in the function. BSF_Holster changes update the cached state at this+0x158 but trigger no per-bit side effect in this handler.
contradictions_with_findings.resolution: state-flag-broadcast.md section 6 corrected. The holster animation mechanism is separate and not yet identified.
